title: A shorthand tag may contain a hash sign
notes: The suffix of a shorthand tag is made of tag characters (production 40): URI characters except `!` and the flow indicators, and `#` is a URI character. The comment indicator needs white space before it, so it does not start a comment here.

provenance.reference: A reader that stopped a tag at a hash sign and then complained that the tag was not followed by white space.
